description: Compare two compatible 12 Axes result links from any domain using the website compatibility formula. For images, first decode each QR with axes_read_result_qr. Returns the largest axis gaps first and a comparison link.

first_url.description: An actual compatible 12 Axes result link from any domain, a relative path, or its query parameters. Requires v with twelve scores or est/rep/pod/imi/dip/int/eco/con/com/rel/mor/tec. A homepage, image filename or placeholder is not a result. Only encoded data is read.
